content: उपसंख्यानम् .²1 Addition. .²2 Supplementary addition, further or additional enumeration (a term technically applied to the {%Vārtikas%} of Kātyāyana which are intended to supply omissions in Pāṇiniʼs Sūtras and generally to supplement them); {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} जुगुप्साविरामप्रमादार्थानामुपसंख्यानम्; <ab>cf.</ab> इष्टि. .²3 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) A substitute in form or sense.
